blurb: Those Without Capital: three films on Muncie, Indiana, a century after Robert and Helen Lynd's Middletown (1929). From Hardwood Bricks, JuiceboxNationTV and 19 North Films. Readings are from Middletown (1929), now in the public domain. Photos: Library of Congress (Lewis Hine, Carol M. Highsmith); Flickr: HystericalMark (CC BY-SA 2.0), Rafaela Ely (CC BY 2.0); map: Norman B. Leventhal Map Center, Boston Public Library (CC BY 2.0). Film: The City (1939).
disclosure: The narration is an AI clone of Matthew's voice, and the readers are AI voices. The music is original.

reels.title: Those Without Capital: Muncie, 1924 to now
reels.text: In 1924, two sociologists moved to Muncie, Indiana, to find out what America actually was. A hundred years later: same town, same caste. Three films. Coming soon.
